QuestInfo.name: Blake's Next Hit
QuestInfo.0: Convince Maestro Rho to compose more songs for Blake.
QuestInfo.1: Maestro Rho says that Blake's recent songs don't feel like the ones from before and he doesn't want to compose more songs for him. He needs the latest hits CDs to listen for differences, which can be found on the 7th and 8th floor.
QuestInfo.2: You listened to the Latest Hits Compilation, but can't make out the differences. Maestro Rho seems frustrated.

0.0: I wonder what kind of song I should compose next... Oh, hello there. Huh? Lana sent you? I thought I already told her I'm done with Blake.
0.1: I used to compose songs for Blake because I liked him, but that's absolutely not the case now. I can't feel any soul in his latest songs either. You know what I mean?

yes.0: Why don't you get his latest CDs and take a listen for yourself? You should find some on the 7th and 8th floor. Just bring back 35 of them.

no.0: Then you should know why I don't want to work with him anymore. Welp, I'll see you around.

1.0: Ah, you brought back the Latest Hits Compilation. Here, take a listen. These are his latest songs.

yes.0: See? You just can't FEEL his soul from his music anymore. Blake's lost that certain something that made him great. You...still don't get it, do you? Well, that's why you're not a musician, I suppose.

item.0: Why don't you get his latest CDs and take a listen for yourself? You should find some on the 7th and 8th floor. Just bring back 35 of them.
